title: Star Wars Just Confirmed Its New Anime Release Window Ahead of Early Premiere
content: Star Wars is making its comeback with a brand new anime series later this year, and it has finally confirmed when it’s hitting our screens ahead of its early premiere for some lucky fans.
author: ComicBook

title: Kagurabachi Anime Reveals World Tour Dates, Episode 1 World Premiere Set for Anime Expo 2026
content: The upcoming KAGURABACHI anime has revealed the dates and locations for the previously announced KAGURABACHI Anime World Tour Part 1, with the first 20 minutes of Episode 1 set to make their world premiere at Anime Expo 2026 in Los Angeles on July 3.
author: Anime Corner

title: Original TV Anime 'Kemono Ou Bushin Dandevine' Announced for Fall 2026
content: Good Smile Company announced on Wednesday an original television anime titled Kemono Ou Bushin Dandevine ( Beast King War God Dandevine ) as part of the company's Gattai-shin Series ( The God of Combined Series ) 25th anniversary project.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Fired? But I Maintain All the Software! Gets Anime
content: An anime adaptation has been announced for the light novel Fired? But I Maintain All the Software! A visual was revealed. No further information such as the studio, staff, cast, and release date, has been released. Yuki Kashirome writes the Fired? But I Maintain All the Software!

title: Anime’s Most Overlooked Sequel Shares New Look at Series’ Return
content: 2026 is set for some of the biggest comebacks in anime history, with the likes of Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War, Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation, Black Clover , and Dragon Ball Super being just a few examples.
author: ComicBook

title: Despite Fans’ Hopeful Wishes, One of Shonen Jump’s Biggest Manga Won’t Ever Return
content: 2026 has been an interesting year for Shonen Jump , as the magazine continues to surprise fans with the debut of many new series while cancelling just as many, alongside bringing several major titles to an end. It is safe to say that for every new series it has introduced, Shonen Jump has also axed another.
author: ComicBook

title: Attack on Titan Just Revealed Its Weirdest Crossover (And Most Missed It)
content: Attack on Titan might be over, bringing the journey of Eren Jaeger and the Scout Regiment to an end, but the bleak anime franchise is still finding ways to stay in the public eye.

title: Dragon Striker Is the Coolest & Most Ambitious Disney+ Series Yet (Review)
content: Dragon Striker has really come out of nowhere, and it’s sure to be a major obsession with Disney animation fans. Disney Television has had some great hits in the past as the latter decades have seen their efforts skew more towards longer form storytelling over the former episodic format.

title: Good Smile Company Announces Original Mecha Anime DANDIVINE, Launches New Combining Robot Toy Franchise

content: The staff for Hokuto no Ken -Fist of the North Star- , the new anime of Tetsuo Hara 's landmark manga Fist of the North Star ( Hokuto no Ken ), revealed three new cast members on Wednesday.
